title: Bitcoin falls to $57,000, its lowest level in over two years; it has lost more than half its value since reaching a peak above $126,000 in October 2025 (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Bitcoin falls to $57,000, its lowest level in over two years; it has lost more than half its value since reaching a peak above $126,000 in October 2025 — Bitcoin fell to the lowest level in over two years, extending its reversal from market darling after the re-election of Donald Trump …
